# Security reporting — GoreeCloud Code

This is a development-stage Fork-To-Native repository derived from Forgejo. Do not post passwords, tokens, private repository data, active exploits, or undisclosed vulnerability details in public issues.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting only if the repository settings expose and enable it. If that channel is unavailable, obtain a verified private contact from the GoreeCloud project owner; do not assume an unverified inbox is monitored.

The imported upstream source and license are documented in [docs/UPSTREAM.md](../docs/UPSTREAM.md). Independent GoreeCloud Code security support windows and production security acceptance have not been established.
